lead: Typography: `Title`, `Text` and `Paragraph` handle single text elements (colour semantics, truncation, copying), while the `Typography` container lays out the native elements of a longer piece of content. The components have no outer margins: leave spacing to `Flex` or `Typography`.

ellipsis.title: Ellipsis
ellipsis.description: Single or multiple lines; truncated text can be expanded (the button only appears when the text is really truncated), and hovering a truncated single line shows the full text.
ellipsis.long: Skein UI separates behaviour from looks: components render semantic markup with data attributes, and every look — spacing, colour, radius, shadow — lives in a swappable skin. Change one attribute on the root element and the whole page changes design language, without touching a single call site.
ellipsis.short: Short enough to fit — no button.

prose.title: Typography container
prose.description: Write native elements inside (or HTML rendered from Markdown): headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code and tables all get their typography automatically.
prose.heading: Why skins
prose.p1: Components describe **structure and behaviour**; a skin describes how they look. Read more in
prose.p2: , or use `data-theme-style` on the root element.
prose.li2: No style hooks — no per-page patches
prose.li3: Dark mode comes with the skin
prose.quote: Consistency is a property of the system, not of each page.
prose.name: Name

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `typography.css`: the type scale, colour semantics, inline styles, truncation and buttons, and the typography of native elements inside the Typography container.
styling.text: `data-tone`, `data-disabled`; when truncating `data-ellipsis` / `data-rows`, `data-truncated` while truncated and `data-expanded` while expanded
styling.parts: The text itself (truncation applies to it); the copy button (`data-copied` after copying); the expand / collapse button
styling.container: The content container; its h1–h6, p, ul / ol, blockquote, code, pre, a, hr and table are styled per element by the theme style
